summary.name: LiblibAI
summary.one_liner: LiblibAI (哩布哩布AI) is a Chinese AI art creation platform and community for sharing original image models, running WebUI and ComfyUI online, generating images and videos, and training LoRA models.
use_cases: run WebUI or ComfyUI without local setup
browse AI art workflows and inspiration
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Chinese-language AI art platform that offers online image and video generation using a range of listed models, including Seedance, Kling, Seedream and Minimax H3. Users can run WebUI and ComfyUI in the browser, and there is a LoRA training feature for online model training. The community section shares over 100,000 original AI painting models that can be downloaded for free. It also includes a discovery area with workflows grouped by themes such as e-commerce rendering, anime, and short drama.
notable: Hosts WebUI and ComfyUI online with no local install
Over 100,000 community models available for free download
Access to 100+ image and video models through one interface
caveats: Free tier is points-based: daily login points and limited generations (about 40 images or 2 videos per the page), so heavier use likely needs paid points or membership
Promotional page; prices and point costs shown are time-limited promotions
Page shows a security verification prompt, so parts of the content may require login
